jtbd.jtbd_title: Refine Stanford essays with parent feedback
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Balance personal narrative with concrete scenes; reduce generalities; keep word-count discipline.

interactions.user_ask: How do I incorporate my parent’s comments without losing my voice?
interactions.jenny_reply: Keep your spine: one lived scene per claim. Accept edits that sharpen details; reject swaps that change tone.
The generalization block—convert to a 3-sentence scene: place, action, micro-outcome.

outcomes.name: stanford_supp_v2
outcomes.details: Reframed generic claim into concrete anecdote; cut 87 words.
